# Lumo UI

> Private, Persian-first, RTL-honest React 19 component library on Base UI, owned by Telarsa. Components are copied into consuming apps (shadcn-style); three contract packages are installed from git.

## For an agent working in ANOTHER project
- docs/agent-consumer.md — the whole workflow: find (lumo search/info), get (lumo add), the five non-negotiable rules, customise, upgrade (3-way merge), report defects
- skills/lumo-ui/SKILL.md — the same as a skill
- catalog.json — every item: title/intro/usage (fa-IR + en-US), tier, required announced strings, required props, files, deps
- api-reference.json — every prop with its docblock, per module
- registry.json — files, npm dependencies, registry closure
- CHANGELOG.md — per-version changes and migration notes

## For an agent working IN this repository
- AGENTS.md — commands, non-negotiable rules, ask-before list, layout
- docs/README.md — map of the docs; docs/rubric.md — how it is rated; docs/goals.md — what is next
- docs/i18n-and-rtl.md — the contract (incl. Latin words inside Persian content); docs/verification.md — every gate and what it proves
- docs/apg.md — keyboard matrix; docs/evidence/README.md — what the browser job proves; docs/decisions/log.md — why

## Commands
- pnpm run verify (everything, ~15 min) · pnpm run evidence (three real engines) · pnpm run mutation:components
- node scripts/lumo-cli.mjs <search|info|list|deps|add|diff|upgrade|gate|doctor>
